تستكرهين (form X)
# تَسْتَكْرِهِينَ (tastakrihīna) /tas.tak.ri.hiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# تُسْتَكْرَهِينَ (tustakrahīna) /tus.tak.ra.hiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
